mainEntity.name: What can go wrong when AI workflow automation fails after I thought it was set up?

acceptedAnswer.text:
Expect some rework. Workflows commonly need refinement because business context is incomplete, sources change, integrations fail, outputs vary, or exceptions were not included in the original design.

## Context
Run My AI Business encourages users to supply context, review drafts, request changes, and refine instructions over time. Its materials also distinguish demonstrated workflows from experimental or not-yet-used examples.

## Key factors
- Quality of the initial process map
- Completeness of examples and rules
- Reliability of connected services
- Frequency of changes in offers, platforms, or source information

## Practical guidance
Pilot with real but low-risk work, log errors, and categorize each failure as a prompt issue, data issue, integration issue, or business-rule issue. Update the workflow deliberately instead of adding random instructions after every mistake.

A tested system is more valuable than a larger collection of unproven examples.
acceptedAnswer.description: Failures may come from incomplete instructions, poor data, changed sources, broken integrations, permissions, or unhandled exceptions. Run a low-risk pilot, log failures by cause, define stop conditions, and review workflows whenever your offer, platform, or business rules change.
